why: Remove the Apple/Samsung design-inspiration reference material (refs/design-inspiration/ -- Apple HIG and Samsung OneUI extractions, images, raw text) from all history. Copyright hygiene on a public repo. Local copies were deliberately kept on disk; only git history and the remote were scrubbed.
note: THIS MAP WAS ONE COMMAND FROM BEING LOST. filter-repo writes its map to .git/filter-repo/commit-map and OVERWRITES it on the next run, and this map is the FIRST link in our rewrite chain -- without it a pre-07-23 SHA cannot be chased at all, and recovery of our broken citations drops from 806 to 86. Nothing had ever read it in the 65 days it sat there.
the_assumption_that_aged_badly: The session that ran this rewrite closed by noting 'every commit SHA in the repo changed -- that's clean for a solo repo like this one, but a clone elsewhere would need a fresh clone rather than a pull'. Correct at the time. What falsified it was our own corpus later learning to cite SHAs: the chronicle, the task ledger, lessons and fence reconciliations now name commits by hash, so the repo became its own downstream clone.
